store.yaml
  format: int

options.yaml (optional): the global Options; a key left out takes its default
  focus_clear: string (optional)

projects/<key>/project.yaml
  key: string
  display_name: string
  created: string
  mode: string
  archived: string (optional)

projects/<key>/specs/<n>.md: YAML frontmatter between --- lines, then the Markdown body
  id: int
  title: string
  labels: []string
  tags: map[string]string
  link: mapping (optional)
      integration: string
      id: string
      url: string (optional)
      external_state: string
      detached: bool (optional)
  created: string
  updated: string
  edits: list of mappings
      number: int
      actor: string
      time: string
      previous: map[string]string

projects/<key>/tickets/<n>.yaml
  title: string
  state: string
  spec: int
  labels: []string
  tags: map[string]string
  blocked_by: []int
  replacements: []int
  link: mapping (optional)
      integration: string
      id: string
      url: string (optional)
      external_state: string
      detached: bool (optional)
  created: string
  updated: string
  description: string
  branch: string (optional)
  commit: string (optional)
  claims: list of mappings
      number: int
      id: string
      session_id: string (optional)
      working_dir: string (optional)
      resume_command: string (optional)
      started: string
      ended: string (optional)
      ended_by: string (optional)
  rounds: list of mappings
      number: int
      claim: int
      session_id: string (optional)
      posted: string
      questions: list of mappings
          number: int
          title: string
          body: string
          recommended: string (optional)
          status: string
          answer: string (optional)
          closed: string (optional)
  failure_reports: list of mappings
      number: int
      claim: int
      session_id: string (optional)
      working_dir: string (optional)
      resume_command: string (optional)
      actor: string
      time: string
      what_broke: string
      why: string
      what_to_fix: string
      where_work_stands: string
  comments: list of mappings
      number: int
      actor: string
      time: string
      claim: int (optional)
      body: string
  moves: list of mappings
      from: string (optional)
      to: string
      actor: string
      time: string
      claim: int (optional)
      via: string (optional)
      commit: string (optional)
  edits: list of mappings
      number: int
      actor: string
      time: string
      previous: map[string]string

values
  options focus_clear (default all_clear): all_clear, activity_dashboard
  ticket state, moves[].from, moves[].to: Draft, Ready, In Progress, Needs Answer, Answered, Failed, In Review, Accepted, Done, Cancelled
  rounds[].questions[].status: open, answered, dismissed
  link.external_state: open, closed, deleted, out_of_scope
  spec edits[].previous keys: title, body, external_state, detached
  ticket edits[].previous keys: title, description, spec, external_state, detached
